title: SCN Cyst Extraction from Greenhouse Cultures
author: Casey A Schlenker

steps.title: Prepare for Extraction
steps.instruction: Put on gloves and prepare the workspace.

substeps.instruction: Lay out small petri dishes on a tray and set aside.

steps.title: Harvest Soybean Plants
steps.instruction: Clip stems from the chosen soybean plant using gardening shears, leaving 1-2 inches of the stem.

substeps.instruction: Dispose of soybean clippings in the steam cart or compost.

steps.title: Set Up Sieve Station
steps.instruction: Prepare the filtration apparatus and water source.

substeps.instruction: Place a white cutting board with a hole on top of a white tub.
Place 20/60 mesh sieves on top of the cutting board hole.
Fill a grey bucket with water and place it close to the crock.

steps.title: Soak and Extract Root Samples
steps.instruction: Flood the crock gently with water using a faucet with long rubber tubing. Once properly soaked, remove the long skinny tube from the center of the crock and set it aside.

steps.title: Wash Root and Tube
steps.instruction: Extract the sample and remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Remove the tag from the sample and set it aside.
Pull the stem and the tube out of the crock simultaneously, ensuring the stem does not rip.
Move the root and tube to the gray wash bucket and gently swirl to dislodge sand and turface from the tube.

steps.title: Dislodge Cysts from Roots
steps.instruction: Use a handheld sprayer to blast the roots on top of the 20/60 sieves.

substeps.instruction: Turn the root over periodically to ensure all cysts are dislodged.
Continue until all turface is dislodged from the roots.

steps.title: Collect and Label Cysts
steps.instruction: Clear the sieves and recover the cysts.

substeps.instruction: Dispose of the root in a 3-gallon bucket.
Using a wash bottle, wash all material from the 60 sieve into a small petri dish.
Replace the petri dish lid and place the corresponding sample tag on top.

steps.title: Process Remaining Samples
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction, washing, and collection process for all remaining tubes in the crock.

steps.title: Clean and Disinfect Crocks
steps.instruction: Thoroughly clean and sanitize the equipment.

substeps.instruction: Wash all growing substrate and plant matter out of the crock and scrub to remove all previous plant material.
Place all PVC tubing (22 in total, including 1 long tube) into the crock.
Fill the crock 80% with water and the remainder with bleach.
Let sit for a minimum of 24 hours.
